Prediction: Cape Coral prints above 6.00 on the Parcl Motivated Seller Index by the 12/15 data date
Resolution_Criteria: Series: Parcl MSI (0-10), Cape Coral metro, current series, daily, value to the hundredth. Vintage: FIRST build carrying each data date (WQ-475, revisable series). TRUE if any first-print value on a CORAL reading with data date 2026-11-06 to 2026-12-15 is > 6.00 (strict). FALSE otherwise. NO-VERDICT if Parcl withdraws the series. Anchor: CHOSEN 12/15, the last reading before the winter composite window opens. Base rate: 47 of 236 overlapping 40-day windows since 2/1/2026 rose by 0.16 or more (19.9%); windows overlap and the series has fallen since April, so I price under it. Comparison: none published. Prior revisions run upward, but the letter uses first prints.
If_Falsified: Cape Coral's fall is not a one-way drift; the season brought sellers back under pressure, and a re-fire is back in play
